title: Grateful Dead Live at Ungano's Night Club on 1970-02-12
source: SBD > 8 TRACK 1" RTR @ 7.5 I.P.S. > MASTER ARCHIVE 24-BIT D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Clear vault soundboard capture of an inspired early‑February ’70 show where Bob Weir is firing on all cylinders.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a solid, vault‑sourced soundboard mix that fans describe as pleasant and clear. The performance is praised as “every bit as inspired” as the celebrated 2‑13‑70 shows, with particular kudos to Bob (Bobby) for his scorching playing throughout an early‑show setlist. While a few reviewers note confusion over the exact date, the overall musical quality is rated highly.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both performance (inspired show, hot Bob Weir) and recording clarity; limited but consistent data across five reviews yields a confident moderate‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vault‑sourced soundboard noted as clear and pleasant; no major audio flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early 2/13‑70 style performance with a different song selection but retaining the energy and inspiration of that era's shows.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby is described as 'hotter than hell' throughout the show.
